text:
Anya: Quick planning thread — want to optimize funnel from webinar to SDR handoff. idea: 1 keynote + 3 focused breakouts, each with its own CTA and follow-up doc.
Jordan: love. which breakouts? cost, private, observability?
Sam: yes. callout: capture breakout choice on signup and tag lead with that property.
Mira: breakout format suggestion: 10m talk + 3m live demo clip + 2m q. tight and demo-forward.
Anya: proposed run-of-show:
00:00 Intro & goals (Anya) 4m
04:00 Keynote: product + economics (Jordan) 14m
18:00 Breakout blurbs (hosts) 3m
21:00 Breakouts A/B/C (12m)
33:00 Regroup: top takeaways (5m)
38:00 Panel Q&A (12m)
50:00 Close + CTAs (10m)
Sam: CTA examples: cost -> "Cut token spend 3x with smarter batching"; private -> "Private VPC deployments, audit-grade"; obs -> "Ship safer with prompt-driven evals"
Kai: infra note: I'll spin a staging endpoint and short demo clips. endpoint: https://staging.redwood-demo/5367. ephemeral key at rehearsal.
Mira: I need a sanitized sample dataset for private demo. Jordan can you scrub?
Jordan: will scrub and upload by EOD tomorrow.
Anya: ops-bot please create rehearsal event Thurs 9am PT and link runbook.
ops-bot: Rehearsal created for 2025-05-15T16:00Z. Runbook posted to #marketing-resources. Recording enabled.
Sam: rehearsal agenda: 10m tech check, 20m demo dry-run, 15m breakout timing, 5m contingency.
Mira: assign Q triage in each breakout to collect top questions for panel.
Jordan: assigning triage leads: Sam (cost), Mira (private), Kai (obs logistics). Anya moderator.
Anya: please send 40-word bios + headshots by Monday. I'll draft landing copy & two socials once CTAs confirmed.
Sam: I'll draft follow-up docs per breakout for SDRs (sell sheet + demo repo).
Anya: excellent — locking slides upload 24h before rehearsal. thanks all :rocket:
